**The Medium-Term Outlook for Nickel and Cobalt Panos Kotseras** **Senior Consultant – Nickel, Stainless Steel and Special Alloys CRU Metal Pages NiCoMo 2013 London, 12-13 March 2013** ## **Structure** - Nickel contemporary trends & prices - Nickel production - - Part 1 Nickel consumption - Nickel market balance & price forecast - Conclusions - Cobalt contemporary trends & prices - Cobalt production - • - Part 2 Cobalt consumption - Cobalt market balance & price forecast - Conclusions 2 ## **Structure** - Nickel contemporary trends & prices - Nickel production - • - Part 1 Nickel consumption • Nickel market balance & price forecast - • Conclusions - • Cobalt contemporary trends & prices - • Cobalt production - • - Part 2 Cobalt consumption • Cobalt market balance & price forecast - • Conclusions 3 #### **Contemporary trends in the nickel market** - Prices under pressure due to an oversupplied market - Consumption supported by Chinese stainless sector - Asia contributed to nickel mine production growth - Chinese nickel pig iron production higher in 2012 - Market surplus expected to continue into 2013 4 Nickel prices have lately been hovering within a narrow range
